[measurement]{.chip .measured} Entry 57 · milestone M4
:::

A bounded diagnostic evaluated each selected local state twice in each solver
backend, with unchanged inputs and a fresh process for every call. Every backend
reproduced its own signed species energy flux exactly. The earlier differences
between backends persisted, including the largest discrepancy in a control state.

| evidence | result |
|---|---|
| saved-output repeatability audit | [521 saved-output checks pass; every within-backend fresh-process repeat is exactly equal and agrees with its consumed output, while all four cross-backend discrepancies persist; native accounting completes within the reviewed bound and the offline archive copy matches its checksum]{.claim}[C-201](/Blog/tokamak-toolkit/claims.qmd#c-201){.cid .st-measured} |
| reference physics and coupled acceptance | remain unresolved |

This narrows the numerical investigation. The discrepancy is reproducible, so
another identical collection would supply little new evidence. It still does
not identify whether the difference comes from build arithmetic, internal inputs
or eigenvalue search behavior. Numerical refinement and implementation comparison
are needed before choosing a replacement reference.

The archive tracking correction also worked in the completed batch job. The
checksum-bound archive preserves relative paths for every replicate; its one
offline tracking copy matches the original. Earlier failed attempts stay failed
and retained. This new successful diagnostic is also consumed and will not be
submitted again.

The literature-based signed reference specification stays conditional. Exact
repeatability is distinct from numerical convergence, physical validity and the
temperature acceptance gate. The current surrogate and guard remain selected,
and the uncovered-face ceiling stays open.

**What's next.** Review numerical refinement and a conservative stable energy
closure before another coupled reference. No model replacement or artifact
synchronization occurred.
